name: Opacity-aware Non-Square Bounding Box
definition: A method to compute a tight, non-square axis-aligned bounding box for a 2D Gaussian based on its opacity and covariance, replacing the original 3DGS method which uses a square bounding box derived from a 99% confidence ellipse radius.
summary: This method computes a tight, axis-aligned rectangular bounding box for 2D Gaussian splats based on projected opacity and covariance, replacing the original square box to improve culling efficiency.
